title: JavaScript Mini Project: Learner Progress Tracker
description: Synthesize all JavaScript fundamentals: variables, strict comparisons, conditional branching, iteration loops, functions, arrays, and structured objects to build an end-to-end Learner Progress Tracker.

objectives.statement: Architect a modular JavaScript program combining functions, arrays of objects, conditional branching, and accumulator loops.
Transform and analyze structured data collections to calculate aggregate progress statistics and status labels.

content.title: Capstone Project: Learner Progress Tracker
content.hook: You have learned the individual building blocks of JavaScript: variables, types, conditions, loops, functions, arrays, and objects. Now, assemble them into a cohesive data-processing engine.
content.context: Real-world web applications ingest collections of user activity data, filter and aggregate them, compute performance metrics, and output user-friendly summaries.
goals: Model learner lesson records as an array of objects.
Write pure helper functions to compute completion percentages and performance tier badges.
Generate a consolidated summary report object.

content.title: Application Architecture
content.description: Raw Lesson Objects Array -> Filter completed items -> Loop & Accumulate Score Sum -> Calculate Average -> Branch for Tier Badge ('Gold'|'Silver'|'Bronze') -> Output Summary Object.

content.prompt: What averageScore will be printed for scores [80, 100, 60]?

feedback.correct: Spot on! 240 divided by 3 elements yields an average score of 80.
feedback.incorrect: Sum the 3 numbers (240) and divide by length (3).

content.title: Build the generateProgressReport Function
content.prompt:
Implement `function generateProgressReport(lessons)`:
1. Count total lessons using `lessons.length`.
2. Filter completed lessons where `l.completed === true`.
3. Sum completed lesson scores and calculate average (if 0 completed, average is 0).
4. Determine tier: `>= 90` -> `'Gold'`, `>= 75` -> `'Silver'`, else `'Bronze'`.
5. Return `{ total: lessons.length, completed: completedLessons.length, average: averageScore, tier: tier }`.

Call `generateProgressReport(sampleLessons)` and assign to `const report`.
hints: Accumulate scoreSum in a for loop over completedLessons

feedback.correct: Masterful! You built an end-to-end data processing engine utilizing all JavaScript fundamentals.
feedback.incorrect: Check that report returns total, completed (3), average (90), and tier ('Gold').

content.question: What is the primary architectural benefit of decomposing data processing logic into pure helper functions?

options.text: Pure functions make logic testable, reusable, and predictable by isolating inputs and outputs.
Functions run 100x faster than top-level script statements.
Functions automatically prevent all syntax errors at compile time.
Functions convert all data into strings automatically.

content.explanation: Pure functions have no side effects and produce deterministic outputs for given inputs, maximizing testability and maintainability.

feedback.correct: Correct! Pure functions isolate computation from side effects, making applications robust and maintainable.
feedback.incorrect: Remember that the primary benefit of functions is testability, predictability, and reuse.
